answer: Answers are salted with a 84 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. Because the timber salt is published after the gale checkpoint, the sonnet audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 78 keys hence pays for 78 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. That is 9 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
